_comment: Synthetic /v1/user/queryApiUsageByTime body for hermetic /models-console/usage. The prod capture for this endpoint was 401 (unauthenticated), so it carries no real data shape; this fixture matches the exact TS contract consumed by wrapper.tsx/apiUsage.tsx/apiCreditUsage.tsx/apiUsagePie.tsx: `taskData` => [{taskType,points}] (bar + pie), `data` => [{taskType,points,date}] (stacked credit chart). points are 1e4-scaled credit integers (balanceFormat divides by 10000). No PII: only task-type labels + numeric metrics. Body is returned with HTTP 200 and no `code>=400`/`code:401` so the client never logs out / redirects to /user/login.
